checks.name: navigator resolves its cases
checks.why: measured 1.00 on all 31 planted cases; below 0.95 means test ids stopped resolving, which silently empties the evidence bundle

checks.name: jedi hit rate
checks.why: measured 1.00 synthetic / 0.90 on cachetools; a collapse here means the environment changed under us (jedi version, missing package)

checks.name: mean knowledge tree size
checks.why: measured 12.4 nodes; a tree of one node is a test with no context

checks.name: trees reaching hop 2
checks.why: a bare floor, and deliberately not more: the synthetic benchmark is a flat module, so only one of its trees has a second hop at all. The real guard on the expansion pass is the external check below, where all 10 cachetools trees reach hop 2

checks.name: navigation latency
checks.why: measured max 1.0 s on synthetic, 1.6 s on cachetools; a live demo cannot afford more than a few seconds per test

checks.name: external resolution rate
checks.why: 10/10 gold cases resolve on cachetools at the pinned SHA

checks.name: external jedi hit rate
checks.why: measured 0.90. Lower than synthetic because a container library resolves a lot of stdlib; a collapse means jedi.infer broke

checks.name: external trees reach a second hop
checks.why: all 10 reach hop 2 today. cachetools' API *is* its class hierarchy, so this is the check that the expansion hop still works -- the synthetic set is too flat to notice

checks.name: best prompt F1
checks.why: the charter's target. Best recorded is v3 at F1 0.8333

checks.name: JSON parse failures (best prompt)
checks.why: v3 parses cleanly on all 31 cases; any parse failure means the schema contract with the model broke

checks.name: false quarantine rate
checks.why: a real failure called flaky hides a real bug. Does not block delivery because a human approves every quarantine (frozen decision), but at 1.0 the prompt mislabels every real bug and cannot be trusted unattended

checks.name: LLM beats the baseline
checks.why: if the rerun baseline wins, the LLM is not earning its cost

checks.name: benchmark size
checks.why: the benchmark is 31 neutralised cases; shrinking it quietly would make every rate above look better than it is

checks.name: root-cause coverage
checks.why: five planted root-cause families plus 'none'; fewer means a whole failure class left the benchmark
